flash.crawl_stopping: The crawl is stopping. Completed records are kept; you can resume it later.
flash.crawl_busy: A running crawl cannot be deleted. Stop it first.
flash.crawl_deleted: The crawl and all of its data were deleted.
flash.resume_not_resumable: This crawl cannot be resumed (only stopped, interrupted or failed crawls).
flash.resume_nothing_to_resume: No URLs are waiting in the queue; there is nothing left to resume.
flash.resume_too_many_crawls: The limit of simultaneous crawls has been reached. Wait for a crawl to finish.
flash.resume_project_busy: This project already has a running crawl.

crawl.permission_text: Zerqon Spider must only be used on websites you own or are explicitly authorised to crawl.
crawl.permission_point_robots: robots.txt rules are always respected; no requests are sent to disallowed URLs.
crawl.permission_point_limits: Your URL limit, depth and speed settings are never exceeded; the crawl slows down automatically on 429/503 responses.
crawl.permission_point_scope: Domains outside the scope are never crawled; external links are only recorded.
crawl.permission_point_local: Access to local networks, localhost and cloud metadata addresses is blocked for security.
crawl.permission_checkbox: I own this website or I am authorised to crawl it.
crawl.permission_note: This confirmation is your own declaration; Zerqon Spider does not verify site ownership automatically.
crawl.localhost_env_off: 'Allow localhost' is selected for this project, but ZERQON_ALLOW_LOCALHOST is not enabled in .env. Local addresses will be blocked.
crawl.settings_snapshot_note: When the crawl starts, a copy of these settings is stored with it; changing project settings later does not affect old crawls.
crawl.stop_confirm: Stop the crawl? Crawled pages are kept and the crawl can be resumed later.
crawl.delete_confirm: This crawl and all of its data will be permanently deleted. Are you sure?
crawl.interrupted_text: The application closed during the crawl. Data saved up to that point is kept; use 'Resume' to continue from the queued URLs.
crawl.cancelled_text: The crawl was stopped by the user. The results shown are partial; you can resume it if you wish.

crawl_errors.generic: The operation could not be completed.
crawl_errors.permission_required: You must tick the ownership / crawl permission confirmation to start the crawl.
crawl_errors.too_many_crawls: The limit of simultaneous crawls (3) has been reached. Wait for a crawl to finish.
crawl_errors.project_busy: This project already has a running crawl.
crawl_errors.internal_error: An unexpected error occurred. Details are in the log file. Saved data is kept; you can try resuming the crawl.
crawl_errors.disk_full: The disk is full. Free up space in the data directory and resume the crawl.
crawl_errors.database_error: The database could not be written. Make sure the data directory is writable and resume the crawl.

issues_ui.none_found_hint: No issues match the selected filters.
issues_ui.prioritization_note: Severities are adjusted for prevalence, page importance and indexability context.

events.localhost_disabled: Localhost was allowed for this crawl, but ZERQON_ALLOW_LOCALHOST is off in .env; local addresses were blocked.
events.crawl_delay_applied: The robots.txt Crawl-delay value was applied.
events.resumed: The crawl was resumed (number of queued URLs).
events.robots_unavailable: robots.txt could not be fetched; to be safe, this host was not crawled.
events.robots_server_error: robots.txt returned a server error; to be safe, this host was not crawled.
events.robots_not_found: robots.txt not found; all URLs were treated as crawlable.
events.sitemap_invalid_url: A Sitemap address in robots.txt is invalid.
events.sitemap_fetch_failed: A sitemap could not be downloaded.
events.sitemap_http_error: A sitemap returned a non-200 response.
events.sitemap_invalid: A sitemap could not be parsed (invalid XML).
events.sitemap_limit: The sitemap file limit was reached; remaining sitemaps were not processed.
events.render_unavailable: JavaScript rendering could not start (Chromium not installed or a system dependency is missing). The crawl continued in standard mode. Install with: python -m playwright install chromium

robots_status.blocked_security: Not requested due to security policy

table.search_placeholder: Search in URL, title or H1…

fetch_errors.timeout_fix: The server was slow to respond. Check server load, or increase the timeout and lower concurrency in the crawl settings.
fetch_errors.dns_error_fix: The domain could not be resolved. Check the spelling, DNS records and your internet connection.
fetch_errors.ssl_error_fix: The SSL certificate is invalid, expired or does not match the domain. Renew/fix the certificate.
fetch_errors.connection_refused_fix: The server does not accept connections on this port. Check that it is running and the firewall settings.
fetch_errors.connect_error_fix: The server could not be reached. Check your internet connection and the server's availability.
fetch_errors.protocol_error_fix: The server returned an invalid HTTP response. Check the server/proxy configuration.
fetch_errors.network_error_fix: The network connection dropped. Check your connection and resume the crawl.
fetch_errors.blocked_security_fix: The address resolves to a local/private network. For a local development site enable localhost mode in .env.
fetch_errors.processing_error_fix: An unexpected error occurred while processing the page; details are in the log file.
fetch_errors.generic_fix: See the log file for details and try the crawl again.

detail.google_index_unknown: Unknown — the real index status can only be verified with Google Search Console.
detail.structured_disclaimer: Only syntax and basic fields are checked; not all Google rich result rules are validated.
detail.not_rendered: This page was not rendered with JavaScript (standard mode, or not needed in hybrid mode).
